meaning.en: In the eighth place; eighth in a row.
meaning.vi: Ở vị trí thứ tám; thứ tám liên tiếp.

sentences.en: Eighthly, what is the civilization form of harmonious development?

Thứ tám, thực hiện kỹ thuật bảo trì hệ thống.

sentences.en: Eighthly, creating new circumstance by innovation system.

sentences.en: Eighthly , strengthen the management of human resources , push the continuous creation of Collcges and Universities Sports Intangible Assets .

sentences.en: Eighthly, commercial banks should strengthen credit personnel training and enhance quality of credit personnel completely.

sentences.en: Eighthly, hand in the double information of the engine number and bodywork number.

sentences.en: Eighthly , we should pay attention to the creating of the policies which can embody practicality and characteristic.

sentences.en: Eighthly, lack of relevant laws and regulations is the institutional origin of PE teachers' misconduct.
sentences.vi: Thứ tám, thiếu các luật và quy định liên quan là nguồn gốc thể chế dẫn đến hành vi sai trái của giáo viên Thể dục.
